Container.Name: jev-mcp
Container.Overview: TypeSafe "Jev" judgment MCP server (verify claims, screen injection, find, rerank, classify, decide, compare, extract fields, review patches, gate completion). stdio bridged to streamable HTTP on port 8933 via mcp-proxy, for registration in MCPJungle. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY to your TypeSafe key (never baked into the image).

Config.Name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Your TypeSafe (Jev) API key. Required. Never committed to the image or repo.
